### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The change is covered by tests, or it is documentation only.
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm check` pass.
- [ ] A changeset is added for every published package whose surface changed, following [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md#writing-changesets).
- [ ] Documentation is updated where the change affects it (`CONTEXT.md` vocabulary, `DESIGN.md` rules, `README.md` adoption, per-item docs).
- [ ] The change adds no raw hex outside the token foundation tier, no token literal and no style override.
- [ ] The new copy contains no em or en dashes.
